sections.heading: 1. Open book
lines: ① Lie on your side, knees bent to 90°.
② Reach both arms out in front.
③ Slowly open the top arm, turning your chest.
④ 8 reps each side, 1–2 times a day.

caption:
Momo's back feels heavy after every dragon boat session. Rowing asks for a lot of hip bend at the catch, while kayak, outrigger and dragon boat paddling drive power through trunk rotation. When hips are stiff or the mid-back doesn't turn much, the lower back and shoulders often end up doing extra work.

Clinical Pilates can target those gaps: hip mobility, rotation and shoulder blade control. One or two sessions a week, ideally on lighter training days, is a good start.

Sharp rib pain, back pain that builds week to week or a shoulder that aches at night is worth an assessment. Our Pilates team at Hybrid Physio starts with an assessment. Book online via the link in bio 🚣
